text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- The Minister of Equipment Joao Cravinho orders audit of work carried out to enlarge Madeira airport. The project is financed 83 percent by the European Union.

- Spokesman for Spanish electricity company Iberdrola says company gave orders to buy the maximum number of shares possible at the privatisation of Portuguese state electricity company EDP-Electricidade de Portugal.
- Social Security expects to recover two billion escudos from stepped up inspections of hypermarkets where some 8,000 workers are not correctly registered with authorities.
- Portugal's gold reserves are amongst the 10 biggest in the world. Since 1988, Portugal has held about 16 million ounces.

- Foreign investment in Portugal has been falling since 1991 when it totalled 545 billion escudos. This year it is expected to fall below 100 billion escudos. The decline is due to opening up of east European countries to foreign investment.
